description:
Alex Crown are delighted to offer this spacious one-bedroom apartment for sale, set on the 4th floor of the well-positioned Westpoint Apartments on Clarendon Road, N8.

The property offers a bright and generously sized open-plan living area with space for both lounge and dining, leading onto a fully fitted kitchen. Large windows and access to a private balcony provide excellent natural light, with pleasant views overlooking North London. The apartment further comprises a large double bedroom with built-in wardrobes, a fully tiled bathroom with bath and shower attachment, and useful storage space throughout.

Westpoint Apartments is ideally located in the heart of Turnpike Lane, offering excellent access to a wide range of local shops, cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities. Transport links are superb, with Turnpike Lane Underground Station on the Piccadilly Line within easy reach, Hornsey Rail Station nearby, and numerous bus routes providing convenient access across North London and into Central London.

This apartment would make an excellent first-time purchase, home, or investment opportunity in a highly connected North London location.
